subject: prd/init-hardening
statement: If a wiring operation fails for permission after the checks passed (scope gaps are not fully pre-probeable), then the system shall complete every remaining operation the credential allows, finish green, and record the handed-off operations with their exact remedial commands — the installer's non-admin hand-off; no rollback occurs for a permission-classified wiring failure
intent: a green install + the hand-off block naming each remaining operation and its command
fit_criterion: injected permission failure at wiring → the run ends green with the hand-off recorded (operations + runnable commands) and the target NOT rolled back; every non-permission post-mutation failure still restores as-found (FR-10)
